profile.headline: Software Engineer & Salesforce Leader 6x Certified, BSc
profile.summary: A resourceful, creative, and talented software engineer with experience in Salesforce, web and Android development. I've worked for about 28 different companies as a software development consultant. I have passion for helping others, teaching others, and building impactful software while doing it.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: Software Design · Software Integration · Salesforce.com Development · React.js · Mobile Applications · Stackstorm · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Python (Programming Language)

positions.title: Owner & Lead Architect
positions.description: Skills: Technical Leadership · Technical Consulting · Client Relations · Salesforce Lightning · Management · Account Management · Salesforce · Sales · Marketing · Mentorship

positions.title: Salesforce Developer
positions.description:
o  Design and implement solutions by doing hands-on development using Apex, Lightning Web Components, Lightning Components, Flows and CPQ
o  Evaluate user requests, creating functional and non-functional requirements, architecting solutions, and working with development teams to develop and deploy solutions
o  Architecting solutions and working with development teams to develop and deploy solutions that bring sales functions together
positions.insights: Skills: Salesforce Sales Cloud · Requirements Analysis · Salesforce.com Development · Salesforce CPQ · Salesforce Lightning · Salesforce.com Administration · Apex Programming

positions.title: Salesforce Technical Lead
positions.description:
o  Act as lead technical resource for project teams
o  Consult client and teammates on best practices as well as best technical path to success
o  Manage technical resources to ensure quality and timely hand-off of project deliverables
o  Estimate and design solutions before guiding team to successful implementation
o  Coach more junior resources on technical, consulting and company-specific topics
positions.insights: Skills: Leadership · Salesforce.com Implementation · Technical Leadership · Requirements Analysis · Salesforce.com Development · Agile Methodologies · Salesforce Lightning · Salesforce.com Administration · Salesforce.com Consulting · Salesforce Training · Team Leadership

positions.title: Senior Salesforce Developer
positions.description:
o  Improved and debugged pre-existing solutions for various established clients
o  Consulted various clients’ software needs in Apex, Visualforce, and Configuration changes
o  Designed and built custom solutions for clients involving both front and back-end needs
o  Learned various new technologies quickly in order to support small practice
o  Led team projects to successful completion as Lead Developer
o  Maintained existing and acquired new certifications while managing regular workload
o  Wore many hats at any given time when needed in order to support small practice and drive projects to completion
o  Maintained pace of work while in Work From Home environment with little to no management necessary
positions.insights: Skills: Salesforce Sales Cloud · Requirements Analysis · Salesforce.com Development · Salesforce.com Administration · Salesforce.com Consulting · Salesforce Service Cloud · Salesforce Training

positions.title: Senior Salesforce Developer/Analyst
positions.description:
o Maintain Salesforce org and its sandboxes to ensure a smooth experience for all users
o Develop administration, apex, and front end changes to the system
o Analyse possible improvements to the system
o Document changes in order to maintain clarity throughout project
positions.insights: Skills: Salesforce Sales Cloud · Salesforce.com Development · Salesforce.com Administration · Salesforce.com Consulting · Salesforce Service Cloud

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
o	Design, develop, code and test Android app for USS Lexington Museum
o	Communicate effectively with IT Coordinator to develop and understand needs requirements throughout the duration of the project
o	Work with team to establish needed changes or improvements to project
o	Implement changes using test driven environment and agile development
o	Continuation of Senior Capstone Project
positions.insights: Skills: Technical Leadership · Android Development · Android Studio · Android SDK · Android Design · Team Leadership

company.name: USS Lexington Museum on the Bay

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
o	Self-taught HTML/CSS in order to successfully complete project
o	Communicated effectively with client to understand and develop requirements throughout the duration of the project
o	Created static website and incorporated PHP forums with minor changes in order to personalize experience
o	Used Illustrator and Photoshop to design and create branding

positions.title: Senior Capstone Project – Team Leader
positions.description:
o	Designed, developed, coded and tested Android app for USS Lexington Museum
o	Led team through all phases of the software development lifecycle for both Android and iOS versions of the app
o	Communicated effectively with client to develop and understand needs requirements throughout the duration of the project
o	Developed user manuals and guidelines as well as thorough documentation of project
o	Success of project led to internship with client

positions.title: Computer Science Research Fellow
positions.description:
o	Conducted research on mobile virtual reality and graphics
o	Developed, design, coded and tested mobile apps using Android and OpenGL 
o	Worked closely with team and mentor to create virtual reality experience
o	Maintained satisfactory performance with team and studies
o	Presented at Texas A&M University-College Station research convention

positions.title: Computer Science Supplemental Instructor
positions.description:
o	Planned and conducted exercises with students to basic computer science principals and techniques including algorithm design, problem solving, and data structures
o	Coordinated with instructor about class structure/material
o	Assisted students with lecture material
o	Assisted students with lab material
o	Conducted a weekly supplemental instruction session
o	Acted as link between instructor and students

positions.title: Computer Science Grader
positions.description:
o	Provided feedback to computer science students for incorrect concepts
o	Debugged C++ programs
o	Coordinated with instructor to identify students’ problem areas

positions.title: Computer Science Peer Leader
positions.description:
o	Planned and conducted exercises with students to basic computer science principals and techniques including algorithm design, problem solving, and data structures
o	Coordinated with instructor and partner about activities/material
o	Assisted students with lecture material
o	Assisted students with lab material
o	Acted as link between instructor and students
